# PowerPlay v1.3.8 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Fixed Fire TV keyboard activation when entering the Home Assistant URL and nine-digit PowerLink pairing code in succession.
- Made remote Up/Down and keyboard Next/Done navigate from URL to code to a selectable Pair action.
- Made Refresh and Disconnect accessible through TV remote focus.
